🕯️ Regina Cole is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Regina kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The village's quarrel was with Regina — and Regina is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Amy, Vinod, Nathan and 2 more speak for Hudson — "Regina trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.

🔥 The fire settles. Nathan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Adaeze mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Amy mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
